dedupe_keys.name: swisstlm3d topographic landscape model of switzerland roads rail public transport

description: swissTLM3D is swisstopo's large-scale topographic landscape model of Switzerland and Liechtenstein, the most extensive and accurate 3D vector dataset of the country. It describes more than 21 million landscape features in eight topics: roads and tracks by category; public transport, with railway lines and other rail systems, shipping routes and public transport stops; buildings, including transport constructions; areas such as transport land; land cover; hydrography; single point objects; and names. Geometric accuracy is 0.2 to 1.5 m in all three dimensions for well-defined features such as roads. The current release is version 2.4, with a data catalogue and change list in German and French and sample data. It is published by the Federal Office of Topography swisstopo. Coverage is Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Access: free download through the federal geodata STAC catalogue in File Geodatabase, Shapefile, GeoPackage and Interlis 2 (DXF by email order), in LV95 and LN02, under swisstopo's own terms, which the STAC catalogue lists as proprietary. Caveats: most documentation is in German or French. It supports building detailed Swiss road and rail network models, hazard exposure of transport assets in 3D and digital twins, and complements the Swiss national passenger transport model and opentransportdata.swiss catalogued here.
